about_the_game:
Story & Background

Are you ready to join an extraordinary adventure and help these talented virtual girls on their path to success? Step into their world with 《OG Streamer Beats》, a unique blend of platforming excitement and rhythm-based gameplay that will inspire and energize you. Get your virtual boots on, adjust your headphones, and immerse yourself in the dynamic beats that will guide your journey!

Demo Features

  • Play as Two Captivating Vtubers

    Get a taste of virtual stardom by stepping into the shoes of two distinct Vtubers, each with their own unique style, personality, and storyline.

  • Preview Exclusive Sexy CG Scenes

    Unlock and preview exclusive sexy CG images for both Vtubers right from the start, offering a glimpse into their special moments.

  • Try Out 4 Rhythm-Platforming Levels

    Dive into four dynamic levels that combine platforming and rhythm-based gameplay. Each level is paired with a carefully chosen song that complements the character’s personal growth and journey to fame.

The full game is coming soon, featuring all four Vtubers, six stunning CG scenes, and 16 incredible songs to amp up the rhythm-based excitement.

content_descriptors.notes:
All characters in the game are over 18 years old.
The game contains explicit adult themes, including nudity, violence, and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
